title: The librarian enters the person's name and email and registers them
A blank name, a malformed email or an email already registered is refused
The library shows the new member with the member ID for their card
The librarian enters the tool's name and, optionally, a description, and adds it
The new tool is in good condition, and the catalog lists it as available
The member borrows an available tool
When a check fails, the borrow is refused with the first failing reason
The library answers with the loan and its due date
The librarian finds the loan and inspects the tool
The librarian records the condition and, optionally, a note
A return with no valid condition is refused
The library answers with the returned loan and whether it was late
The catalog shows the tool as available, or as needing repair
A librarian marks a damaged tool as needing repair, with a note
The catalog shows the tool needing repair, and borrowing it is refused
Once fixed, the librarian marks the tool repaired, and it is available again
